openingSummary.zh: 过去约两日主线从「安全专用模型」切到「Agent 记忆 / 科学评测 / 密码压测」：Anthropic 工程博客《The components of agent memory》把跨会话记忆拆开，并用「dreaming」离线整理日志、纠错与建 wiki；OpenAI 与 Ligo 发布 BioBasicsBench（100 项湿实验日常分析），GPT‑6 Astra xhigh 约 66.7% vs GPT‑5.6 Sol 43.8%；同步与 Frontier Model Forum 推出网络向 jailbreak 评级框架。DeepMind 展示人机协作 Agent 加速对遗留 1024-bit RSA 的密码分析（现代 2048+ 仍安全）。产品侧 Cursor 上线与 Agent 的实时 Voice Chat。Tibo 延续「超安全基础设施终态」叙事。GPT‑6 Cyber 昨日已详报，今日降级带过。缺口：@karpathy / @AndrewYNg / @Meta 近 48h 无高信号原创；关注列表无 DeepSeek 一手 X。
openingSummary.en: Over ~48h the lead shifted from cyber-specialized models to agent memory, science evals, and crypto stress-testing: Anthropic’s Engineering post *The components of agent memory* details cross-session memory with offline “dreaming” (log consolidation, corrections, wikis); OpenAI+Ligo launched BioBasicsBench (100 wet-lab routine tasks)—GPT‑6 Astra xhigh ~66.7% vs GPT‑5.6 Sol 43.8%—and with Frontier Model Forum a cyber jailbreak rating framework. DeepMind showed human-guided agents accelerating cryptanalysis on legacy 1024-bit RSA (modern 2048+ still safe). Product-wise, Cursor shipped realtime Voice Chat with agents. Tibo continued the hypersecure-infrastructure end-state narrative. GPT‑6 Cyber was covered yesterday—brief today. Gaps: @karpathy / @AndrewYNg / @Meta quiet on high-signal originals; no DeepSeek primary X on the watchlist.

summary.zh: Anthropic 工程博客讲 Agent Memory：用「dreaming」（离线整理日志/纠错/建 wiki）让 Claude 跨会话学习；强调告诉模型记忆用途而非具体写法。
summary.en: Anthropic Engineering on agent memory: “dreaming” (offline log consolidation, corrections, wikis) helps Claude learn across sessions—tell the model what memory is for, not how to write it.

caption.zh: The components of agent memory 卡片图（来源：@AnthropicAI / anthropic.com）

summary.zh: OpenAI 与 Ligo 发布 BioBasicsBench：100 项湿实验日常分析任务测 Agent；GPT‑6 Astra（xhigh）均分约 66.7%，相对 GPT‑5.6 Sol 的 43.8% 明显提升。
summary.en: OpenAI+Ligo launched BioBasicsBench—100 wet-lab routine analysis tasks for agents; GPT‑6 Astra (xhigh) ~66.7% mean reward vs 43.8% for GPT‑5.6 Sol.

summary.zh: OpenAI 与 Frontier Model Forum 推出 jailbreak 评级框架，用能力增益/范围/部署与发现难度统一评估会解锁严重网络危害的越狱，便于优先加固。
summary.en: OpenAI with Frontier Model Forum released a jailbreak rating framework (capability gain/scope, ease of deploy/discovery) to prioritize cyber-harmful safeguard bypasses.

summary.zh: DeepMind：人机协作下 AI Agent 加速密码分析，在遗留 1024-bit RSA 上发现两类重要弱点；现代 2048-bit+ 仍安全，但硬度假设需持续压测。
summary.en: DeepMind: human-guided AI agents accelerated cryptanalysis, uncovering two major weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA; modern 2048-bit+ remains safe, but hardness assumptions need ongoing stress tests.

summary.zh: Tibo：人类并不擅长写安全基础设施；终态应是人人可用的超安全软硬件，但到达前会经历动荡（呼应 GPT‑6 Cyber / 内核安全叙事）。
summary.en: Tibo: humans were poor at secure infrastructure; end-state is hypersecure software for all, but turbulence comes first—echoing the GPT‑6 Cyber / kernel security arc.

alphaxivTop3.title: HarnessFlow: MCTS-Guided Harness Optimization for LLM Agents
alphaxivTop3.authors: SCUT / FDU / Wuhan University / Cornell / UC San Diego / CUHKSZ / Microsoft Research Asia et al.

summary.zh: （Agent/Harness 优先）用 MCTS 引导的 harness 搜索+可复用机制库；六基准上优化后均分 69.48%，相对初始 harness / Meta-Harness 分别约 +10.89 / +3.95pp，且任务均成本更低（作者自报）。
summary.en: (Agent/Harness pick) MCTS-guided harness search + reusable mechanism library; optimized harnesses avg 69.48% across six benches, +10.89/+3.95pp vs initial/Meta-Harness with lower avg per-task cost (author-reported).

alphaxivTop3.title: Meta²: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents
alphaxivTop3.authors: Lingzhi Yuan, Feijiang Han, Furong Huang et al. (UMD)

summary.zh: （Agent/Harness 优先；约 #12 Trending）离线学「如何/何时演化 harness」的指导，在线单次长程运行中动态演化 prompts/工具/记忆/钩子；面向可复用知识的 RSI 视角。
summary.en: (Agent/Harness pick; ~#12 Trending) offline-learned guidance on how/when to evolve the harness, applied dynamically within each long-horizon run (prompts/tools/memory/hooks); RSI-flavored reusable knowledge.

alphaxivTop3.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
alphaxivTop3.authors: Yuqi Huang, Bo Mao, et al. (Shanghai Qiji Zhifeng)

summary.zh: （Computer-Use Agent 优先；约 #12 Trending）Experience Flywheel + NorthCUA Harness 规模化采集可验证轨迹；未解任务用 RSI 演化可复用技能，再经 staged learning 强化 GUI/长程能力。
summary.en: (CUA pick; ~#12 Trending) Experience Flywheel + NorthCUA Harness for verified trajectories at scale; RSI evolves reusable skills on unsolved tasks, then staged learning builds GUI/long-horizon competence.
